original.statement: In Flux 2.7.0, the CLI uninstall now also removes ArtifactGenerators.

decision.reason: [ev-ca5d9cebd770] says only that the CLI changelog now removes `ArtifactGenerators` during uninstall. That is a real change to how the uninstall command behaves when nothing is configured differently, so behavior-changed is the right change type. The evidence names no API group, version, flag or key, so the kebab-case free-form name "uninstall-artifactgenerators" works as the identity. protocol-behavior is not a clean fit, because it is meant for wire-level behaviour, but no listed family covers a command's own semantics better.
